feedback: Written before this candidate races, so no outcome is claimed for it. The evidence is iteration 10 (score 724.1, the best raced design): oval 20/20 at about 2.0 s, s-bend 20/20 at about 2.2 s, and slalom 1/20 with progress 0.64, max_error about 0.061 and rms_error about 0.018. Dropping base_speed from 1.3 to 1.1 at fixed y=0.08 raised slalom progress from 0.56 to 0.64 and gave the first slalom finish, so speed was a real lever. The candidate changes one variable against that baseline: kp 3.0 to 3.2, with geometry, base_speed 1.1, kd 0.8, ki 0.02 and last_direction line loss unchanged. It is inside the contract limits and is a small step. Iteration 4 (kp 3.7) hurt slalom and s-bend, but it also changed the array and kd, so it does not rule out a small kp rise. This is the final iteration, and there is no budget for a second review round that would still leave a race, so the candidate should be approved now. After the race, read the results in this order. (a) If oval or s-bend completion falls below 20/20, that is the main risk of kp rising, and the 500-point bonus outweighs the rest. (b) If steering_oscillation rises above about 0.35 on any track, kd is too low for the new gain, so kd should go toward 0.9. (c) If slalom max_error stays near 0.061 with no progress change, steering gain is not the limit, and the difference is within noise.
requested_changes: If the next race shows oval or s-bend completion below 20/20, revert kp from 3.2 to 3.0, since iteration 10 finished both at 20/20 and the completion bonus outweighs any slalom gain.

If steering_oscillation rises above about 0.35 on any track, raise kd from 0.8 toward 0.9 with kp held, because iteration 10 oscillation was 0.29 to 0.31 and higher kp with the same damping adds jitter.
Keep base_speed 1.1 and sensor y 0.08 unchanged, because iteration 10 showed slalom progress rising from 0.56 to 0.64 at the lower speed.
